readings: z is a combinational Moore output; it reflects the current state in the same cycle
z is a registered output; it updates on the next positive clock edge, one cycle after the state changes
reset only synchronously clears the state to 000; z remains a function of the current state until the next clock edge
reset forces z to 0 as soon as reset is high (or on the reset edge), independent of the current state
state register initializes to 000 at power-up (or before first clock), so z is defined before reset
state register initializes to an unknown value (or one of the don't-care states 101/110/111), so z is undefined until the first reset edge
states 101,110,111 are don't-care; any next state and output value is acceptable
states 101,110,111 must have defined next states (e.g., return to 000) and a defined output z (e.g., 0) to avoid undefined behavior
